summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core) of cipher-box in a single autonomous session while the user was AFK.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (7 plans across 4 waves, plan-checker passed on iteration 2 after one fix cycle). Execution started with Wave 1: 63-01 finished (navigation walk + NavigateResult union, 7 tests passing), 63-02 dispatched. Waves 2–4 and /ship-phase were not reached before the transcript ends.

repo: Phase 63 scope: read-chain navigation walk, grant/invite crypto, rotation engine, plus 4 named Phase-64 seams stubbed in 63-03.
GSD config for this project: research + plan_check + nyquist + pattern_mapper all enabled; researcher=sonnet, planner=opus, checker=sonnet.

Sequential execution in main tree (no worktrees) is the preferred mode here due to shared folder.test.ts between 63-01/63-04 and documented worktree pitfalls (node_modules leaks, api:generate conflicts).
API health check: port 3000, endpoint /health, CI polls with `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` in a bounded loop — not a raw sleep.
Commit signing was already disabled repo-locally (commit.gpgsign: false); no action needed before autonomous runs.
Branch feat/read-chain-navigation-and-rotation-core was already created from planning; executors reuse it — never re-fork off main after planning commits land.
Pattern mapper found 10/10 analogs; API-SURFACE regenerated to 0 symbols (sdk-core is pure backend, no exported API surface at this stage).
Plan coverage: 7 requirements (READ-01–05, ROT-01–02) and 10 decisions all covered by the 7 plans.

code.finding: Original plan used `sleep 12` for API startup wait; replaced with a bounded health-poll loop mirroring CI's curl pattern against localhost:3000/health.

workflow: GSD commit helper consistently reports false-negatives (exit-code or output says failed) but `git log` confirms commits landed — do not retry on this signal, always verify via git log.

Plan-checker iteration 1 raised 1 blocker (RESEARCH.md Open Questions lacked RESOLVED markers) and 2 warnings (VALIDATION.md body unfilled, fragile sleep in 63-07). All were artifact/formatting issues, not design flaws — fixable in-context without replanning.
Nyquist VALIDATION.md: template is written at step 5.5 with frontmatter only; per-task verification map is filled after planning, not at template time.
Drift gate (stale .planning/codebase/ map) is non-blocking at plan time — skip refresh when CONTEXT.md + RESEARCH.md carry precise, verified implementation-site references.
When all plan-checker findings are artifact-level (not design flaws), fix them directly and re-spawn the checker for a clean second-pass rather than routing back to the planner.

friction: GSD commit helper false-negatives on every commit throughout the session — required `git log` verification after each commit to confirm success, adding noise to every step.

Plan-checker iteration 1 required a fix cycle for issues that were purely formatting/artifact gaps (RESOLVED markers, unfilled template) rather than substantive plan problems — a second full checker spawn just to clear housekeeping items.
Codebase map stale drift warning appeared mid-plan but was non-blocking — created ambiguity about whether to refresh before proceeding.
Transcript ends mid-execution (63-02 dispatched, no result shown) — full outcome of execution and ship steps unknown.
